info.title: json-compress command line
info.description: Command line for json-compress: compress, restore, measure, minify, beautify and validate JSON documents. Install with dotnet tool install --global TechStyle.JsonCompress.Cli.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: json-compress - lossless JSON compression that is still JSON

commands.name: stats
commands.description: Report what compression would save, and change nothing

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Check the document parses, and say where it does not

options.name: --out
options.description: Write to a file instead of standard output

options.name: --no-strings
options.description: Do not build a string-value catalogue

options.name: --no-tables
options.description: Do not pack arrays of objects into tables

options.name: --no-constants
options.description: Do not hoist unchanging columns out of rows

options.name: --no-dict-columns
options.description: Do not encode low-cardinality string columns as indices

options.name: --min-rows
options.description: Smallest array that may become a table (default 2)

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the version
With no input file, the document is read from standard input.
